premortem: Do not use chapter fallback, headings, paragraphing, dialogue labels, source identifications, witnesses, or punctuation as boundary authority.
Do not atomize imperatives, maxims, analogies, names, rich charges, patience examples, or prayer cases.
Do not detach question from answer, dialogue from reply, claim from example, warning from remedy, or analogy from conclusion.
Do not isolate Jas.2.24, 3.1, 4.5, 5.6, 5.14, or 5.16 as proof texts.
Do not decide direct source dependence, faith/works doctrine, law, economic/discipline/office/healing/prayer policy, identity, canon, witness, authorship, or theology.
Keep four parents and exact routes live; all decisions remain LOW, deferred, candidate-only, non-authorizing, without forced consensus.
